program_name: Community Initiatives Fund of Saskatchewan Community Grant Program
amount_notes: Amount not confirmed from source. TBD.
organization_types_eligible: Incorporated Saskatchewan nonprofit organization in good standing with ISC
Municipality or First Nation proposing community-based community-led programs
Health region, school or school board for community-based programs
eligibility_criteria: Must be incorporated Saskatchewan nonprofit in good standing with Information Services Corporation (ISC)
Primary purpose must be to benefit Saskatchewan communities
Program must align with CIF funding themes: children and youth development, or nonprofit capacity building
Community programs for youth facing financial, accessibility or other barriers receive higher priority
Programs must result in children and youth being physically literate and physically active
exclusions: Organizations not in good standing with CIF (outstanding reports or repayments)
